## Description

Use the MACD line crossing its signal line, often with a zero-line or trend filter.

## Where it may fit

Moderate trends and momentum transitions; crossover noise is common in flat markets.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

Close prices; EMA history; optional volume and higher-timeframe trend.

## Caveats

Indicator is a transformation of price, not independent information.
